data_source.note: Acoustic laughter labels (not VTT discourse positions)

model.name: v2 LaughO
model.head: Linear(768) -> LN -> GELU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(256) -> LN -> GELU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(1)

validation_protocol.split_strategy: GroupKFold by video_id, video IDs shuffled per seed

results.verdict: Strong signal on acoustic laughter labels, but high fold variance suggests n is small. NOT publishable as headline; needs scale-up.

comparison_to_baselines.HaHaScore_v10_comparable_task: humor/laughter detection on StandUp4AI VTT discourse positions
comparison_to_baselines.v2_LaughO_comparable_task: ROC-AUC on AudioSet acoustic laughter labels
comparison_to_baselines.comparison_warning: These are NOT directly comparable. Different tasks (acoustic vs discourse), different metrics (AUC vs IoU-F1), different label sources. The +0.05 v2 vs v10 gap is suggestive but unverified due to task difference.

limitations.single_shard: Results from 1 of 35 AudioSet eval shards (~650 MB / 500 rows)
limitations.small_n: Likely 500-2000 laugh + ~2500-10000 non-laugh samples from one shard
limitations.high_std: std=0.18 vs v10 std=0.14; 1-shard estimates are noisier
limitations.not_publishable_as_headline: Needs >=5 shards, n>=5000, repeat-rerun for stability

next_steps: Scale to all 35 AudioSet eval shards (~22.5 GB total, 4 GPU h T4)
Add AMI Meeting Corpus (100h speaker-disjoint, 2 GPU h)
Re-run 5x3 CV on full dataset (~12 GPU h total)
Compare v2 LaughO to v10 ONNX on common 12-video StandUp4AI gold set
Submit to arXiv as 'AudioSet-only laughter detector with 5x3 repeated CV'
